name: 12210 · Albany, NY
findings: ZIP 12210 (Albany) has 164 nonprofit organizations. 96 of them (59%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 92 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 12210 (Albany) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 12210 (Albany) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 8.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 92 organizations here; 18% of all organizations here have no identified type.
